acceptance.criterion_verbatim: RENDERED, NOT GREPPED. Read screenshots: the eight-book Positioning Summary with no clipping; the satellites view with no selector, defaulted to cottonwood. THE CANVAS IS SILVER.

Canvas law holds -- notices are dark text on a light tint, all content sits inside dark Panels, and the header actions slot now carries only the mode pills. acceptance.criterion_verbatim: THE GRADIENT RUNS ORANGE -> YELLOW -> GREEN -> BLUE -> RED, LEFT TO RIGHT, ORANGE ON Satellite 15. Do NOT derive the direction from the Duration values.
acceptance.invocation: read render of the PORTFOLIO COMPOSITION chip row at 1920
acceptance.output_evidence: Orange on Satellite 15 (leftmost) through red on Satellite 90 (rightmost). DIRECTION WAS NOT DERIVED FROM DURATION: that column falls left-to-right (2.89 ... 1.81) and reads as 'shortest is rightmost', which would invert the gradient. Andrew's stated reason is that the falling value is a MISNOMER -- equity weight rises rightward and equity has no duration, so the blended average falls because the fixed-income sleeve shrinks. The inference was available, was made by another seat, and was wrong.
acceptance.denominator: 8 chips; first = orange stop, last = red stop.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: EVERY DISPLAYED BOOK GETS ITS OWN COLOUR -- INTERPOLATE, DO NOT CYCLE. THE SPAN IS THE SET AC1 LEAVES RENDERED -- EIGHT books, not nine.
acceptance.invocation: bookColorRamp(n) evaluated against the pre-change BOOK_COLOR_CYCLE[i % len] for every mode's actual book count
acceptance.output_evidence: satellites n=8 -> 8 DISTINCT colours (old cycling gave 5 of 8 -- it repeated). AND THE DID-NOT-MOVE CONTROL, ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN VISUAL: models n=5 ramp == old cycling IDENTICAL; etfs n=4 ramp == old cycling IDENTICAL. Interpolating unconditionally would have SILENTLY RECOLOURED ETF MODE, because 4 books against 5 stops is exactly where indexing and interpolation disagree (indexing gives orange/amber/green/blue; interpolation would give orange/blend/blend/RED). The ramp is derived from books.length at the call site, so the span is the DISPLAYED set and AC1's filter feeds it.
acceptance.denominator: 3 modes checked; 2 byte-unchanged; satellites 8 of 8 distinct.

mutant.description: THE MUTANTS ARE INPUTS AND COUNTS, NOT PLANTED DEFECTS. (1) The four render fixtures: three distinct hashes across four states, and the pair that collides is the pair TO-8-DE designed to collide. (2) The colour ramp evaluated at every mode's ACTUAL book count -- the interesting case is etfs n=4, where the naive fix and the gated fix DISAGREE, so 'models and etfs unchanged' is a result rather than an assumption. (3) The typechecker was exercised earlier this session on this same tsc project (planted TS2322 -> rc=2, restored byte-identical), which is what makes rc=0 evidence rather than a possible cached skip on a project-references build.
mutant.expected: Each mutated input must produce a DIFFERENT observable where the code distinguishes it, and an IDENTICAL one where the code must not.
mutant.observed: FIRED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. Distinguished: satellites 8 -> 8 distinct colours against 5 repeats before; populated/empty/failed all distinct. Deliberately identical: models and etfs ramps byte-equal to the old cycling; empty and failed hashes byte-equal to their TO-8-DE values, which is the pre-TO-9 render restored.

determinism.method: Six captures from separate invocations of one instrument against fixed fixtures, compared by sha256; the ramp compared by recomputation against the pre-change expression rather than by eye.
determinism.observed: STABLE. The failed/as_of-null pair reproduced byte-identical hashes; the other states reproduced mutually distinct ones; the ramp comparison is pure arithmetic over fixed inputs.

declared_exclusions.item: Any change to SATELLITE_MEMBERS, the registry or the producer
declared_exclusions.reason: Render-layer only, by the TO's section 2. AC2 exhibits the served artifact unchanged. SAT-b-5: 98 holds eleven accounts and 90 holds zero, so a membership edit would delete the populated book and keep the empty one.
Andrew asked for it commented and not deleted, so other firms' custom models can re-enable it later. AC5 keeps re-enabling to an uncomment.
It would silently recolour ETF mode (n=4 against 5 stops is where indexing and interpolation disagree). Those chips are not this TO's to move.

surprises: OBSERVATION / ARMED at the product level, not a defect in this build -- AC3's width problem is NOT fully solved by removing the ninth column. Measured: 1440 clips, 1600 clips the 8th bar's value labels, 1920 fits. Andrew's premise ('that would solve the issue with the width') holds at wide viewports and not at common laptop ones. Surfaced to the issuer, who amended the criterion; no remedy attempted on this lane's judgement.

OBSERVATION / INERT -- one eslint WARNING is left unsuppressed by choice: setSelectedFirmId is unused because only the commented selector calls it. Renaming it _setSelectedFirmId would silence the warning and BREAK the uncomment-only property AC5 requires. The warning is the cheaper of the two and is better visible than hidden; it clears itself the moment the selector is re-enabled.

OBSERVATION / INERT -- the instrument could not evaluate its own criterion. ui-smoke was pinned to a 1440 viewport, so a criterion of the form 'N columns fit' would have been answered with the clipping of one arbitrary width reported as a property of the page. --width was added (default unchanged) rather than reporting a width-dependent result as width-independent.
